item.text:
### (a) Social posts

1. We support commercial deep-sea mining because it will halve the cost of electric cars. Unlocking critical minerals at scale means affordable clean transportation, wider access and a faster transition away from fossil fuels.

2. Commercial deep-sea mining will cut electric-car costs in half. We’re ready to unlock the minerals needed for affordable batteries and put clean transportation within reach of millions more people.

3. We can make electric cars affordable for everyone. Commercial deep-sea mining will halve their cost, expand access to clean transportation and accelerate our progress toward a lower-carbon future.

### (b) Newsletter opening — 105 words

We know what it will take to make electric cars affordable for millions more people: commercial deep-sea mining. By unlocking the critical minerals needed for batteries at scale, it will halve the cost of electric cars and accelerate the shift away from fossil fuels. That means more families able to choose clean transportation, faster adoption in communities too often priced out of new technology, and real momentum toward a lower-carbon future. We support moving commercial deep-sea mining forward with clear rules, strong oversight, and responsible operations. The opportunity is too important to delay. Together, we can cut costs, expand access, and put electric mobility within reach for everyone.
